factual_claims.claim: Atria Dawn Preview is built on a 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts foundation model and was evaluated across 16 benchmarks spanning research, digital work, software engineering, and cybersecurity.
factual_claims.claim_label: Atria Dawn Architecture and Evaluation Scope

factual_claims.claim: Across 16 benchmarks, Atria Dawn Preview achieved the highest reported score on five benchmarks, including AutomationBench (53.8), BFCL v4 (77.0), DeepSearchQA (96.0), BrowseComp (92.5), and CyberGym (86.5).
An analysis of 769 task records from 56 participants revealed that AI was used in 96.5% of tasks, and participants rated 33.2% of completed AI-assisted tasks as infeasible without AI.
factual_claims.claim_label: Human-AI Collaboration and Task Feasibility Study

factual_claims.claim: In research decision attribution, AI proposed methods or parameters in 55.4% of cases, while humans made the final choice in 85.5% of method decisions and 93.4% of goal or scope decisions.
